'''Tegett''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Black Fleet Crisis]]. He flew an X-wing [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] with bright [[Color/Legends|red]] markings and was stationed on the ''[[Mandjur]]''. During the [[Battle of N'zoth]], his fighter was used by [[Plat Mallar]], who sacrificed himself by flying the X-wing into the path of a [[Yevetha]]n [[Starship/Legends|ship]] attempting to ram the ''Mandjur''.<ref name="Tyrant's Test" />
